## League of Legends: LCS Summer Championship

* **October 4, 2026 – Grand Finals:** Team Liquid Alienware defeated LYON **3-1** to capture the LCS 2026 Summer Championship. With the victory, Team Liquid claimed the domestic title and North America's top seed at the 2026 World Championship, while runners-up LYON secured direct entry into the Worlds main stage. Jungler Josedeodo was awarded Finals MVP.
* **October 3, 2026 – Lower Bracket Final:** LYON eliminated Cloud9 with a **3-1** series win to advance to the Grand Finals. The result locked Cloud9 into third place, sending them to the Worlds 2026 Play-In stage.

## Aston Villa

* **October 4, 2026 – Women's Super League:** Aston Villa Women drew **1-1** against Crystal Palace Women at Villa Park. Noelle Maritz put Villa ahead in the 55th minute before Crystal Palace's Abbie Larkin struck a 30-yard equalizer to split the points heading into the international break.
* **October 2, 2026 – Friendly (Antonio Puerta Trophy):** Aston Villa defeated Sevilla **3-1** in Spain. After trailing to a 52nd-minute strike from Sevilla's Isaac Romero, Villa rallied with second-half goals from Ross Barkley, Alejandro Garnacho, and academy product Max Jenner to lift the memorial trophy.
* **Next Fixture:** Aston Villa return to competitive action on **October 10, 2026**, hosting Brentford in the Premier League.

## Gaming & PlayStation

* **October 9, 2026 – EU Regulators Target Predatory In-Game Monetization:** European consumer protection authorities, led by the Italian Competition Authority, initiated coordinated regulatory actions against 10 major publishers—including Activision Blizzard, Ubisoft, and Riot Games.
